title: Share of boys of lower secondary school age achieving minimum proficiency in mathematics, by population type
subtitle: The share of children who achieve minimum [math](#dod:math-proficiency) proficiency by the end of [lower secondary](#dod:lower-secondary-education) education, where students can demonstrate skills in computation, application problems, matching tables and graphs, and making use of algebraic representations. Compares all children in the age group versus only those enrolled in school.
